name: DIAGNOSE
summary: Disciplined diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions: reproduce, minimise, hypothesise, instrument, fix, regression-test — in that order, never skipping ahead.
prevents: Guessing fixes — patching symptoms without understanding root cause, creating new bugs while masking the original.

cursor.rule_description: Use when facing a hard bug, unexpected behaviour, performance regression, or any failure where the cause is not immediately obvious.
cursor.skill_description: agentgrammar DIAGNOSE — structured reproduce → minimise → hypothesise → instrument → fix → regression-test loop. Never skip ahead. Use when the user invokes /agentgrammar-diagnosing-bugs or is stuck on a hard bug.
